name: guards
description: Keeps AI credit out of commits, PRs, issues, comments and releases, holds PR bodies to the PR format, and stops the streaming CI log watcher, by running the hook scripts in `guards/scripts/` on every shell call. Optionally blocks helper agents.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: never blocks, logs what it would block (and what the guard scripts blocked) to mods-data/guards/decisions.jsonl. enforce: blocks.

attribution.title: Attribution check
attribution.description: on (the default): the attribution script runs on every shell call, keeping AI attribution out of commits, PRs, issues, comments and releases. off: that script does not run.

helpers.title: Helper agents
helpers.description: allow (the default): guards never touches subagents, forks or workflows. block: Agent and Workflow calls are refused in enforce mode and logged in shadow mode, unless the person types /guards helpers allow in that session.
